rules.description: The graph root MUST exist in the supplied Block set.
The supplied Block set MUST NOT contain duplicate blockHash values.
Every resolved edge MUST point from a known child Block to a known parent Block.
The resolved graph MUST be acyclic.
Any parent hash not present in the block set and not declared as an external boundary MUST cause verification to fail. Applies in both closed-world and open-world modes.
External parent boundaries declared in the verification context MUST NOT be used when validationMode is closed-world.
In open-world mode, any unresolved parent not declared as an external boundary MUST fail verification.
Every external parent declared in the verification context MUST be referenced by at least one block in the graph.
